cards.title: Reunión humana alrededor de una mesa luminosa
cards.description: Consistent AgntiaPro art direction: warm editorial European design magazine, ivory #fcfaf6, ink #242421, subtle violet #6550dd and champagne gold #b49665 only as accents, beautiful natural materials, refined realism, quiet cinematic light, generous negative space, excellent photographic composition. No readable text, letters, logos, branding, UI, watermarks, neon, futuristic dashboards, stock-photo clichés. Candid editorial photograph of a small diverse professional team collaborating around a light oak table, natural gestures and authentic expressions, notebooks and simple tools, daylight studio, warmth and dignity, spacious framing, subtle violet accent in the environment.
